name: nguyenthuan2412/pixelforge
description: High performance image processing for PHP on libvips, with a sharp-like fluent API (resize, crop, composite, AVIF/WebP/JPEG/PNG/GIF/TIFF, animation) and very low memory use.

configure-options.name: with-pixelforge-vips
configure-options.description: Prefix of a libvips (vips-cpp >= 8.15) installation, e.g. the sharp-libvips bundle from scripts/install-libvips.sh. Default: pkg-config
